title: rostraria balansae
intro: Rostraria balansae, commonly known as Balansa grass or Balansa fescue, is a perennial grass species native to Europe and Asia. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its ability to reduce inflammation and improve respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Rostraria balansae include its expectorant, anti-inflammatory, and antispasmodic properties, which help to relieve coughs, bronchitis, and other respiratory conditions. The bioactive constituents of Rostraria balansae include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
